comments.content: [medium] This OR chain is verbose, and the product ID constants don't follow a consistent casing convention (e.g., `SN30_Pro` versus the conventional `SN30_PRO`). Rewriting it as a switch statement would improve both maintainability and correctness.

Please update all new `#define` statements so product names use ALL_CAPS and comment spacing is standardized.
